scope: HouseClass::HasInfSelfHeal / HasUnitSelfHeal and GetInfSelfHealStep / GetUnitSelfHealStep: the count predicate and the count x amount step of the Tech Hospital and Tech Machine Shop self-heal.
assumptions: The fixture house carries only House+0x164 and +0x168.
The fixture Rules block is reached through 0x008871E0 and carries only the two amount fields plus a sentinel.
substitutions: The other counter and the other Rules amount field hold sentinels, so a row that read the wrong one differs.
TechnoClass::AI_Update's two arms and the three BuildingClass lifecycle sites are read from instructions, not executed here.
